headline: WSN @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.50 at TBR 4.22, with a projected total of 8.72. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved +0.64 runs while TBR moved +0.07, changing the projected margin by +0.57 runs. The projected total climbed +0.77, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Griffin Jax has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nasim Nuñez, James Wood, Yandy Díaz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chandler Simpson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
